data/14/entries/8/entries/17/entries/1.english: The cracks in the floor were made by the golem in {@area area X10|5f3|x}. The arrow slits are 5 inches wide, 2½ feet tall, and 1 foot thick. They look down on the temple ({@area area X5|5df|x}).
data/14/entries/8/entries/17/entries/1.zh_tw: 地板上的裂痕是{@area 區域 X10|5f3|x}的魔像造成的。箭孔寬5吋、高2½尺、厚1尺，從中可以俯瞰神殿（{@area 區域 X5|5df|x}）。

data/1/entries/0.english: Under raging storm clouds, a lone figure stands silhouetted against the ancient walls of Castle Ravenloft. The vampire Count {@creature Strahd von Zarovich|CoS} stares down a sheer cliff at the village below. A cold, bitter wind spins dead leaves about him, billowing his cape in the darkness.
data/1/entries/0.zh_tw: 狂怒的風暴雲下，一道孤獨的身影矗立在鴉閣城堡的古老城牆前。吸血鬼伯爵{@creature Strahd von Zarovich|CoS|施特拉德·馮·扎洛維奇}從陡峭的絕壁上俯視巴洛維亞村。寒風呼嘯，捲起枯葉在他身旁打轉。他的披風在黑暗中獵獵翻飛。

data/0/entries/0/entries/0/entries/4.english: I remember thinking at the time, What are {@i you} doing here? This creature seemed completely out of place with the kobolds, orcs, and gelatinous cubes we had seen thus far. This was a creature who deserved his own setting and to be so much more than just a wandering monster. When I came home from that game, I told all these thoughts to Laura.
data/0/entries/0/entries/0/entries/4.zh_tw: 我記得自己當時在想：{@i 你}怎麼會出現在這裡？和我們此前遇過的狗頭人、獸人、膠質方塊相比，這個生物顯得格格不入。牠值得擁有自己的舞臺，遠不該只是個遊蕩怪物。那次遊戲結束回家後，我把這些想法全都告訴了勞拉。

data/1/entries/4/entries/1/entries/0.english: This adventure is a retelling of the original {@i Ravenloft} adventure, which was published in 1983 by TSR, Inc. In the years since, the original has gained a reputation as one of the greatest {@b Dungeons & Dragons} adventures ever, and it went on to inspire the creation of a campaign setting of the same name in 1990: Ravenloft, home of the Domains of Dread.
data/1/entries/4/entries/1/entries/0.zh_tw: 本冒險重新演繹了TSR公司於1983年出版的原版{@i 鴉閣魔域}冒險。多年來，原作被譽為有史以來最出色的{@b 龍與地下城}冒險之一，並啟發了1990年同名戰役設定的誕生：鴉閣魔域，恐懼領域的所在之地。

data/1/entries/4/entries/7/entries/0.english: Much of the adventure's action is driven by the clash between the adventurers' decisions and Strahd's goals, and the adventurers and the vampire are all caught in strands of fate that are represented by a special card reading detailed in {@area chapter 1|021|x}, "Into the Mists." Before you run the adventure, you need to conduct that reading to determine the location of several items that are key to the story, as well as one of the locations where Strahd can be found.
data/1/entries/4/entries/7/entries/0.zh_tw: 這場冒險中的許多事件，都由冒險者的決定與施特拉德的目標之間的衝突所推動。冒險者與這名吸血鬼同樣困在命運之網中；這些命運由一次特殊的卡牌占卜呈現，詳見{@area 第1章|021|x}「踏入迷霧」。主持冒險之前，你必須先進行這次占卜，決定幾件劇情關鍵物品的位置，以及其中一處能找到施特拉德的地點。

data/2/entries/0.english: Eerie mists surround Barovia and bind its inhabitants there. This chapter gives you the information you need to prepare for the adventurers' journey into those mists. The chapter first outlines the history and goals of Count {@creature Strahd von Zarovich|CoS} so that you are prepared for what awaits the characters. In the "{@area Fortunes of Ravenloft|01d|x}" section, the chapter walks you through the tarokka card reading that helps set the stage for the adventure's action, and the chapter closes with adventure hooks that you can use to draw the characters into the horror of Barovia.
data/2/entries/0.zh_tw: 詭異的迷霧環繞巴洛維亞，也將居民囚禁於此。本章提供冒險者深入迷霧之前所需的準備資訊。首先概述{@creature Strahd von Zarovich|CoS|施特拉德·馮·扎洛維奇}伯爵的歷史與目標，讓你準備好迎接角色們將面對的一切。「{@area 魔域天機|01d|x}」一節會帶你進行塔羅卡牌占卜，為冒險中的事件布置舞臺；本章最後則提供冒險契機，讓你將角色引入巴洛維亞的恐怖之中。

data/2/entries/2/entries/5/entries/1/ent.english: Hearts = Glyphs Diamonds = Coins Spades = Swords Clubs = Stars
data/2/entries/2/entries/5/entries/1/ent.zh_tw: 紅心＝雕紋；方塊＝硬幣；黑桃＝寶劍；梅花＝星星

data/3/entries/14/entries/10/entries/0/e.english: Even here, in the mountains, the forest and the fog are inescapable. Ahead, the dirt road splits in two, widening toward the east. There you see patches of cobblestone, suggesting that the eastern branch was once an important thoroughfare.
data/3/entries/14/entries/10/entries/0/e.zh_tw: 即使來到山間，你們仍無法擺脫森林與迷霧。前方的土路一分為二，通往東方的岔路逐漸變寬。那裡仍看得見一片片鵝卵石鋪面，顯示東邊的岔路曾是一條重要通道。

data/6/entries/6/entries/2/entries/6/ent.english: If the characters earn the trust of the wereravens in Vallaki, the Keepers of the Feather will watch their backs. The next time the characters get themselves in serious trouble, you can have a group of {@dice 1d4} {@creature Wereraven|VRGR|wereravens} show up to rescue or otherwise help them.
data/6/entries/6/entries/2/entries/6/ent.zh_tw: 如果角色們贏得瓦拉吉鴉人的信任，羽衛就會在暗中照應他們。下次角色們陷入重大危機時，你可以安排{@dice 1d4}名{@creature Wereraven|VRGR|鴉人}現身救援，或以其他方式協助他們。

data/8/entries/7/entries/6/entries/0.english: A {@creature revenant}, as described in the {@book Monster Manual|MM}, has a year to achieve its revenge before its body crumbles to dust and its soul enters the afterlife. In Barovia, however, a revenant can remain in its body indefinitely, and once it has reaped its vengeance, its soul remains trapped in Barovia.
data/8/entries/7/entries/6/entries/0.zh_tw: 如{@book 怪物圖鑑|MM}所述，{@creature revenant||還魂鬼}只有一年的時間完成復仇，隨後其身體就會化為塵土，靈魂則進入來世。然而，在巴洛維亞，還魂鬼可以無限期地留在自己的身體中；即使完成復仇，其靈魂仍會困在巴洛維亞。

data/9/entries/5/entries/12.english: The windows of the north wing are made of leaded glass that is translucent—good for letting in light but not good for seeing through. The windows of the east wing are broken outward and have damaged shutters.
data/9/entries/5/entries/12.zh_tw: 北翼的窗戶是以鉛條鑲嵌的半透明玻璃，能讓光線透入，卻看不清窗外。東翼的窗戶向外破裂，百葉窗也已損壞。

data/13/entries/13/entries/3/entries/0.english: A light drizzle begins to fall. Unpainted fences blindly follow the trail, which skirts north of a sprawling vineyard before bending south toward a stately building. The fog takes on ghostly forms as it swirls between the neatly tended rows of grapevines. Here and there, you see rope-handled half-barrels used for hauling grapes. North of the trail is a large stand of trees. A man wearing a dark cloak and cowl stands at the edge of the trees, beckoning you.
data/13/entries/13/entries/3/entries/0.zh_tw: 細雨開始飄落。未上漆的柵欄沿著小徑一路延伸；小徑繞過大片葡萄園的北側，再向南轉往一棟氣派的建築。霧氣在照料整齊的一列列葡萄藤之間翻湧，幻化出鬼魅般的形影。各處散放著用來搬運葡萄的半截木桶，桶上裝著繩索提把。小徑北方有一大片樹叢，一名身穿深色斗篷、戴著兜帽的男子站在樹邊，向你們招手。

data/22/entries/1.english: Although the workmanship and artistic quality of the cards can vary from deck to deck, the ability of the cards to call forth information about the future is far more valuable than the monetary worth of a deck.
data/22/entries/1.zh_tw: 雖然每副牌的製作工藝與藝術品質不盡相同，牌組揭示未來資訊的能力，卻遠比它本身的金錢價值珍貴。

data/22/entries/3/entries/1.english: Each suit contains cards numbered one through nine, plus a tenth card that is called the master of that suit. A card can be referred to by its suit designation or by its name. For instance, the three of glyphs is also known as the {@card healer|Tarokka Deck|CoS}, and the {@card wizard|Tarokka Deck|CoS} card is also known as the master of stars.
data/22/entries/3/entries/1.zh_tw: 每種花色都有編號1至9的牌，以及第10張稱為該花色「主牌」的牌。每張牌都可以用花色與編號，或用牌名來稱呼。例如，雕紋3也稱為{@card healer|Tarokka Deck|CoS|醫療師}，而{@card wizard|Tarokka Deck|CoS|法師}牌也稱為星星主牌。
